source_locator: R2256: Tenth Army, 8 September, Radom force includes the 7th Infantry Division (HyperWar, Campaign-III)
current_activity: 7th Infantry Division is part of the Polish force at Radom
notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-08, cited below. Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (1939) (R2256, HyperWar, Campaign-III), says the Radom force on 8 September 1939 included the Krakowska Cavalry Brigade and 7th Infantry Division of the Cracow Army, together with survivors of the 3rd, 19th and 29th Infantry Divisions and the 12th Infantry Division from the general reserve, and that Tenth Army destroyed the Polish force at Radom by 11 September and took 60,000 prisoners. The claim is dated 8 September, when Kennedy places the division in that force; a separate 11 September destruction pin is not added, because he does not say every named unit surrendered in the city on that day. The existing 1 September Częstochowa claim is not rewritten. Event definition: A dated headquarters, movement or surrender location in the September 1939 campaign.
